schema_note: Canonical public URLs for agents and buyers. Regenerate: npm run docs:sync-endpoints (reads repo-root .env). Commit result for GitHub Pages. Stable HTTPS + mainnet alignment: documentation/PUBLIC_MAINNET_OPERATIONS.md

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL x402 seller (discovery origin)
endpoints.description: Discovery appends each SKU path from x402_providers.json. With unified Caddy, base URL ends with /t54.

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL well-known catalog
endpoints.description: Machine-readable XRPL SKU catalog for agent discovery (paths, drops, payTo, facilitator).

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL agent card
endpoints.description: Agent capability card listing T54/LCG XRPL skills and endpoints.

endpoints.label: T54 XRPL — LCG Procurement Readiness Scan
endpoints.description: Entry SKU for LCG procurement intelligence on XRPL (POST JSON; GET ?payload= also supported).

endpoints.label: Base USDC x402 seller (facilitator / Bazaar)
endpoints.description: Full GET /x402/v1/query URL for Coinbase Bazaar / x402 clients.

endpoints.label: Base USDC intake resale (same packs as T54 XRPL)
endpoints.description: GET /x402/v1/intake-resale?pack_id=<uuid>. USDC settles to X402_SELLER_PAY_TO. Override URL with X402_INTAKE_RESALE_PUBLIC_URL.

endpoints.label: Celo native x402 seller (api_402 / fulfillQuery)
endpoints.description: GET/POST /celo/query — HTTP 402 with CELO payment via AgentRevenueService.fulfillQuery (no facilitator). Set CELO_402_PUBLIC_URL or PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN.

endpoints.label: Marketplace HTTP (Stripe MPP, buyer API, webhooks)
endpoints.description: Stripe MPP + buyer API + webhooks: unified Caddy maps /webhooks/stripe, /v1/*, /marketplace/* to marketplace:serve (8055). Same public HTTPS origin as x402/T54 when MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL matches your tunnel.

endpoints.label: MCP T54 x402 (SSE, remote clients)
endpoints.description: Streamable HTTP (Smithery): POST .../mcp (port 9052, mcp>=1.23). SSE: GET .../mcp/sse, POST .../mcp/messages/ (9051). Caddy: exact /mcp → 9052; /mcp/* → 9051. Set MCP_SSE_PUBLIC_URL to your public HTTPS origin + /mcp.
